notes.source: server/utils/files/multer.js:18-21 (fix parent) filename: function (_, file, cb) { file.originalname = Buffer.from(file.originalname, "latin1").toString("utf8"); cb(null, file.originalname); } - file.originalname is the multipart upload's filename, chosen by the manager/admin uploading a document

Nothing normalised it before multer opened the destination file. The fix wraps each name in normalizePath() from server/utils/files/index.js, which path.normalize()s and strips leading ../ sequences. Second explanation: source (the multipart filename).
notes.fix: runs every kept upload filename through normalizePath() before multer writes it
